parameters.query:
SELECT 
  co.id,
  co.guest_name,
  co.guest_email,
  co.guest_phone,
  co.total_amount,
  co.order_data,
  co.created_at,
  co.updated_at,
  co.cart_age_days,
  co.abandoned_whatsapp_sent,
  co.abandoned_reminder_sent,
  -- Calcular edad en horas laborables
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - co.created_at)) / 3600 as horas_inactivo
FROM guest_orders co
WHERE co.status = 'carrito_creado'
  AND co.abandoned = true
  AND co.abandoned_whatsapp_sent = false
  AND co.cart_age_days >= 1
  AND co.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  -- Validar que el cliente tenga datos registrados
  AND co.guest_email IS NOT NULL
  AND co.guest_email != ''
  AND co.guest_phone IS NOT NULL
  AND co.guest_phone != ''
  AND co.guest_phone LIKE '57%'
  -- No enviar si ya se envió recordatorio hoy
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM recordatorios_enviados r
    WHERE r.cliente_telefono = co.guest_phone
      AND r.tipo = 'carrito_abandonado_whatsapp'
      AND r.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '20 hours'
  )
ORDER BY co.cart_age_days ASC,
  co.created_at ASC
LIMIT 20;

INSERT INTO recordatorios_enviados (
  cliente_telefono,
  cliente_email,
  cliente_nombre,
  tipo,
  mensaje_enviado,
  metadata,
  sent_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.cliente_telefono }}',
  '{{ $json.cliente_email }}',
  '{{ $json.cliente_nombre }}',
  '{{ $json.tipo }}',
  '{{ $json.mensaje_enviado }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.metadata) }}',
  '{{ $json.sent_at }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (cliente_telefono, tipo, sent_at)
DO NOTHING;

RETURNING id;

  order_id,

  cart_age_days,
  urgency,

) VALUES (

  '{{ $('📈 Crear Métricas').first().json.status }}',
  {{ $('📈 Crear Métricas').first().json.cart_age }},
  '{{ $('📈 Crear Métricas').first().json.urgencia }}',
  {{ $('📈 Crear Métricas').first().json.total }},
  {{ $('📈 Crear Métricas').first().json.productos }},
